Based on the data in the carrier master table (`tms_carr`), we currently have 65 carriers on file.

ANSWER: 65

queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_carriers, COUNTIF(actv_flg) as active_carriers FROM tms_carr
SELECT * FROM tms_carr LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT carr_id) FROM tms_load_hdr
SELECT DISTINCT on_time_ind FROM ptl_shpmt LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*),
       COUNT(CASE WHEN on_time_ind = 'Y' THEN 1 END) as ot_y,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN on_time_ind = 'N' THEN 1 END) as ot_n,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN on_time_ind IS NULL THEN 1 END) as ot_null
FROM ptl_shpmt
WHERE req_dlvr_dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'

SELECT COUNT(*),
       COUNT(CASE WHEN on_time_ind = 'Y' THEN 1 END) as ot_y,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN on_time_ind = 'N' THEN 1 END) as ot_n,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN on_time_ind IS NULL THEN 1 END) as ot_null
FROM ptl_shpmt
WHERE actl_dlvr_dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
SELECT * FROM ptl_shpmt WHERE req_dlvr_dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' LIMIT 10
SELECT stat_txt, COUNT(*), COUNT(on_time_ind) FROM ptl_shpmt GROUP BY stat_txt

SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(CASE WHEN on_time_ind = 'Y' THEN 1 END) as ot_y
FROM ptl_shpmt
WHERE req_dlvr_dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' AND stat_txt = 'Delivered'
SELECT stat_txt, COUNT(*) FROM ptl_shpmt WHERE req_dlvr_dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY stat_txt
SELECT stat_txt, COUNT(*) FROM ptl_shpmt WHERE actl_dlvr_dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY stat_txt

SELECT
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM actl_dlvr_dt) as yr,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM actl_dlvr_dt) as mo,
  COUNT(*) as total_delivered,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN on_time_ind = 'Y' THEN 1 END) as ot_y,
  ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN on_time_ind = 'Y' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) as ot_pct
FROM ptl_shpmt
WHERE actl_dlvr_dt IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY yr, mo
ORDER BY yr, mo

SELECT
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM req_dlvr_dt) as yr,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM req_dlvr_dt) as mo,
  COUNT(*) as total_shpmt,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN stat_txt = 'Delivered' THEN 1 END) as total_delivered,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN on_time_ind = 'Y' THEN 1 END) as ot_y,
  ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN on_time_ind = 'Y' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN stat_txt = 'Delivered' THEN 1 END) * 100, 2) as ot_pct_of_delivered,
  ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN on_time_ind = 'Y' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) as ot_pct_of_all
FROM ptl_shpmt
GROUP BY yr, mo
ORDER BY yr, mo
SELECT stop_typ_cd, COUNT(*) FROM tms_stop GROUP BY stop_typ_cd

SELECT s.shpmt_ref, s.load_id, s.req_dlvr_dt, s.actl_dlvr_dt, s.on_time_ind,
       st.appt_start_lcl, st.appt_end_lcl, st.arr_ts, st.dep_ts, st.tz_nm
FROM ptl_shpmt s
LEFT JOIN tms_stop st ON s.load_id = st.load_id AND st.stop_typ_cd = 'DL'
WHERE s.req_dlvr_dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-05'
LIMIT 10
SELECT stop_typ_cd, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT load_id) FROM tms_stop GROUP BY stop_typ_cd
SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT load_id) FROM ptl_shpmt
SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(CASE WHEN test_flg = true THEN 1 END), COUNT(CASE WHEN void_flg = true THEN 1 END) FROM tms_load_hdr
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tms_load_hdr WHERE test_flg = false AND void_flg = false

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tms_load_hdr h
LEFT JOIN ptl_shpmt p ON h.load_id = p.load_id
WHERE h.test_flg = false AND h.void_flg = false AND p.load_id IS NULL

SELECT h.load_stat_cd, COUNT(*) FROM tms_load_hdr h
LEFT JOIN ptl_shpmt p ON h.load_id = p.load_id
WHERE h.test_flg = false AND h.void_flg = false AND p.load_id IS NULL
GROUP BY h.load_stat_cd
SELECT load_stat_cd, COUNT(*) FROM tms_load_hdr GROUP BY load_stat_cd

SELECT h.load_stat_cd, p.stat_txt, COUNT(*) FROM tms_load_hdr h
JOIN ptl_shpmt p ON h.load_id = p.load_id
GROUP BY h.load_stat_cd, p.stat_txt
